heroHeadline: Russia Hits Energy Grid With 365 Missiles and Drones as Abu Dhabi Talks Near
heroSubtitle: A Nov 2-3 strike hit energy sites in nine oblasts; another 128-drone attack followed Nov 4-5. Zelensky proposes an Istanbul summit while technical talks are expected in Abu Dhabi around Nov 10-11.
